sentences.text:
This second application for seeking suspension of sentence and grant of bail has been argued on the ground that victim, who was a major girl and was in love relationship with the appellant, has falsely implicated him; in this rape case prosecution has failed to place the FSL as well as DNA report on record and even the MLC report of victim suggests that she sustained no injury in the incident, while her statements reveal that she was given nail scratches, her hair were pulled so badly that some were de-rooted and some substance was thrown in her eyes rendering her temporarily blind; strangely,
no physical symptoms were found by Medical Officer regarding any of these injuries allegedly caused to the victim 2 CRA-6212-2018 during commission of crime.
On these grounds, a request has been made for allowing the application for suspension of sentence and grant of bail.
The State has opposed this application for suspension of sentence and grant of bail claiming that the appellant does not deserve any leniency in the light of gravity of his crime.
Counsel for both the parties have been heard and the record is perused.

Having heard the arguments of parties and on examining the evidence available on record, we deem it appropriate to suspend the Rakkoo Alias Rakesh Sen vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 12 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/73077291/
1 jail sentence of appellant and to release him on bail.
